Products.label: Products
Products.title: From ideas to code.
Products.description: A selection of products, tools and experiments where I take part directly in defining, designing and building digital solutions.

kontororu.description: A content manager for teams and clients who need to publish to several sites from one place, each with its own brand and permissions.
kontororu.problem: Running one CMS per client multiplies work and risk. Kontorōru centralises content with strict isolation between workspaces.
kontororu.note: It manages the blog and case studies on this site.

tanzo.tagline: A suite of UX and planning tools
tanzo.description: A set of tools to shape and organise products: sitemaps and flows (Kōsei), card sorting (Kādo) and visual roadmaps (Rebyū).
tanzo.problem: Information architecture and planning work tends to be scattered across generic tools that don't talk to each other.

bijon.description: A Tanzō tool that analyses an experience and flags likely usability and conversion friction before launch.
bijon.problem: Friction is often found late, once the experience is live and fixing it costs more.
bijon.ai: Analysis and chat about the experience using a Gemini model.
